blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Employed solo parents may still see PhilHealth deductions from their October pay if their membership records have not yet been updated to reflect their status as a solo parent. Under PhilHealth Circular No. 2026-0015, the National Government will shoulder the portion of PhilHealth premiums previously paid by qualified employed solo parents, while employers will continue paying their share. However, the exemption from the employee share is tied to the member’s classification in PhilHealth’s system.
